changelog:
v4.2.0 — Phone Touch Overhaul + Playback Fixes

PHONE:
• Movies, Series, and Live TV lists now scroll properly with your finger (they were stuck before).
• Single tap now opens anything on the first tap — no more double-tapping cards, categories, or the Home buttons.
• Returning from a video no longer pops the keyboard or jumps you around.

PLAYBACK (all devices):
• Broken or mislabeled titles now fail fast with a clear message instead of spinning for ~50 seconds, and the app retries with the correct file format automatically.
• If a title can't play in the built-in player, you can open it in VLC or MX Player when installed.
• Fixed an audio glitch that could trigger a full mid-movie reload on some movies.

The Fire TV experience is unchanged.
